 Print Bollywood celebrities marked Diwali 2026 with grand celebrations, sharing glimpses of their festivities with fans on social media. Among the pictures that have caught everyone's attention are those of Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone celebrating the festival in Bengaluru with their family and close friends. Several photographs from their intimate gathering have surfaced online, giving fans a peek into how the couple spent the special occasion. A group photograph, which has been widely shared by fan pages, shows Ranveer and Deepika posing for a cheerful selfie with her family and friends. The gathering included Deepika's parents, Prakash and Ujjala Padukone, her sister Anisha, and a few close friends. The photograph appears to have been taken at a restaurant after their Diwali meal. Watch Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar sparks Hollywood chatter after John Krasinski’s big statement Deepika looked elegant in a yellow ethnic suit, with her hair styled in a neat bun, while Ranveer opted for a vibrant purple kurta paired with a silk brocade jacket. The couple were seen smiling for the camera alongside their loved ones. Another picture from the evening shows Deepika posing with a member of the restaurant staff, while a separate photograph captures Ranveer happily clicking a selfie with a fan. Meanwhile, Ranveer and Deepika have been embracing a new chapter in their personal lives. The couple welcomed their second daughter on September 19, 2026. In October, they shared a heartwarming family photograph featuring themselves, their elder daughter Dua and their newborn, while also announcing that they had named their second daughter Devi Padukone Singh. For the unversed, Ranveer and Deepika tied the knot in a grand destination wedding at Lake Como, Italy, in November 2018. The celebrations featured ceremonies conducted according to Konkani and Sindhi traditions. The couple welcomed their first daughter, Dua Padukone Singh, on September 8, 2024, followed by their second daughter, Devi, on September 19, 2026.
